newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Telecom aims a HK listing in 4th qtr - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Telecom aims a HK listing in 4th qtr - paper.

text.p: China Telecom (Hong Kong), an indirectly controlled unit of the China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, aims to seek a Hong Kong listing in October or November, the South China Morning Post said on Thursday.
"The company's parent, China Telecom, has requested due diligence in a number of key assets which potentially could be injected into the Hong Kong company," the newspaper said.
The newspaper said the potential issue size of the company was still unclear but it could be about US$8 billion.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
China Telecom had said earlier it was studying a listing for the Hong Kong subsidiary but gave no indication of the size or timing.
Last Friday, China Telecom agreed to buy a 5.5 percent stake in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd from Cable and Wireless Plc for HK$14.25 a share.
